status: Proposed Cargo ownership and interface targets; not a production SDK or serialized result format.

contracts.status: No-track replacement false success is native-reproduced. Save-error masking is source-only. The result proposal is model-only.
contracts.proposedChange: Propagate replacement failures independently of tracking mode and report actual replacement effects. Preserve metadata failures and partial outcomes rather than derive success from one result.
affectedCallers: cargo install CLI and wrappers consuming its status or installed/replaced text.
contracts.compatibility: Correct false success at the normal entry point; successful cases keep existing meaning. New structured partial-result fields require opt-in or versioning. No format migration for truthful propagation.
contracts.keepCurrent: Independent path/readback can limit exposure in this pinned version, but retaining false success does not satisfy truthful completion.
remaining: Qualify injected tracking-write failures, no-track replacement with other file types, cleanup/status errors, and Windows.
Do not present the four source-only finite cases as native observations.

contracts.status: Mixed-new/replacement registration inconsistency is native-reproduced; old model admits successful tracking writes. Fault and cleanup design remains open.
contracts.proposedChange: Choose retention after confirmed ownership publication or registration of post-cleanup survivors; keep successful replacement prefixes and unknown metadata effects explicit.
affectedCallers: Installation listing and registered-bin uninstall preflight.
contracts.compatibility: Preserve source/package ownership and both tracking formats, including v1-to-v2 synchronization and old/new writers. Registration is not content authentication.
contracts.keepCurrent: Keep ordinary partial replacement and explicit force, but correct the demonstrated registration/cleanup disagreement. A universal rollback promise would change established effects.
remaining: Separate v1/v2 save outcomes, interrupted/truncated writes, save failure after effects, orphan failure, and concurrency.
Preserve uncertain backing; no selected journal, atomic metadata format, or recovery implementation.

contracts.status: Runner CLI/environment mismatch is native-reproduced in earlier evidence; relative-origin consequence remains source-only.
contracts.proposedChange: Resolve a nonmergeable value and the definition that supplied it together through existing typed helpers.
affectedCallers: Runner configuration and configuration-relative executable paths.
Neighboring nonmergeable consumers require separate review; no credential/browser execution was tested.
contracts.compatibility: Preserve syntax, mergeable arrays, environment parsing, item origins, and relative-path semantics. Correcting the winner changes conflicting-runner behavior.
contracts.keepCurrent: Remove the environment override explicitly when requesting the CLI runner in the observed profile.
remaining: Scalar and array forms, explicit configuration origins, empty/invalid values, repeated CLI options, and relative programs.
Review helper consumers before changing a shared configuration boundary.

contracts.status: Preservation and integration proposal using existing bounded evidence; no new resolver, build, or feature qualification.
contracts.proposedChange: Carry request, selection, unit, source, and execution context with existing inspection facts; separate compiler events and raw child streams.
affectedCallers: CLI wrappers, IDE integrations, metadata caches, and operation reports.
contracts.compatibility: Preserve opaque IDs, metadata/lock formats, source-access policies, and existing build/run/test meanings. An extended public view is additive and versioned.
contracts.keepCurrent: Existing metadata, tree, compiler events, and diagnostics are sufficient when their caller retains the correct scope.
remaining: General resolver/source/feature combinations and artifacts, scripts/extensions, all hosts, and process containment.
No automatic promotion from the selected fixtures to whole-feature or whole-program completion.

limits: No Cargo production patch or upstream issue. Current upstream status is unreviewed.
Native no-track behavior, current source interpretations, old scoped evidence, and proposed result rules remain distinct.
Cleanup/durability and full application coverage remain incomplete.
